title: Xanthe and the Cipher
author: Felix Quintana
blurb: Wendell Ashgrove, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
